info.name: Microsoft Word Open XML SDK
info.description:
RESTful representation of the Open XML SDK operations for Word document processing. Provides programmatic access to create, read, and manipulate Word documents (.docx) using the ECMA-376 Open XML standard without requiring Microsoft Office installation.

Contact Support:
